list.title: Your results
list.purpose: Every test you have handed in, newest first. Open one to see your score, skill map and what to practise next.
list.emptyText: Your results appear here after you hand in a test. The free skills test takes 90 minutes.
list.loadError: Please refresh the page in a minute. If it keeps happening, use Need help.
list.help: Provisional means the computer has checked your files and a trainer has not confirmed the score yet. Final means a trainer has confirmed it.

page.purpose: Your score, your skill map and the training path we recommend.
page.notFoundText: The link may be wrong, or these results belong to another account.
page.notSetUpText: We are still setting up results. Please check again soon.
page.errorText: Please refresh the page in a minute. If it keeps happening, use Need help.

header.provisionalHelp: A trainer still needs to confirm your drawing. Your final score may change slightly. You'll get an email.
header.reportNote: The report is one page: your score, skill map, per-area table and top 3 recommendations.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.meaning: You're at the start. The training builds your skills step by step from the basics.

developing.name: Developing
developing.meaning: You have the basics. Focused practice on your weakest areas will move you up fast.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.meaning: You're solid in most areas. Sharpen your speed and accuracy to compete at a high level.

competition_ready.name: Competition-ready
competition_ready.meaning: You're working at competition level. Keep practising under real timing to stay sharp.

howTo.title: How to read this page
howTo.b1: Overall score: your marks across the skill areas this test covered, weighted the way the competition weights them.
howTo.b2: Skill map: one point per skill area. Further from the centre is better; dashed lines are areas this test did not check.
howTo.b3: Task feedback: what each task checked, what you missed in plain words, and where to read how to fix it.

skillMap.title: Your skill map
skillMap.purpose: Your score in each of the six competition skill areas.
skillMap.chartLabel: Skill map: your percent in each skill area
skillMap.levelHelp: L1 0-19 %, L2 20-39 %, L3 40-59 %, L4 60-74 %, L5 75-89 %, L6 90 % and above. Training levels follow the same ladder.
skillMap.weightHelp: How much of the competition's marks this area carries. Your overall score uses these weights.

coverage.organisation: Work organisation is checked in mock competitions, where you hand in a full results folder.
coverage.software: Software skills are checked in mock competitions and in the Get Ready steps.
coverage.modelling: 3D modelling is checked in the free test and every mock competition.
coverage.rendering: Rendering and animation are checked in the design-challenge mock (module 2).
coverage.reverse: Reverse engineering is assessed in person at the studio, with a real part to measure.
coverage.drawing: Technical drawing is checked in the free test and the mock competitions.

modules.title: Competition module readiness
modules.purpose: How ready you are for each competition day this test touched.
modules.help: The competition has four standalone modules on four days. This shows your score on the parts of this test that belong to each one.

tasks.title: Task feedback

methodHelp.auto: Our grader opened your STEP file and checked it against the answer. Each check is pass or fail.
methodHelp.checklist: A checklist runs first, then a trainer confirms every item and scores presentation from 0 to 3.
methodHelp.trainer: A trainer marks this task by hand.

tasks.allPassed: Every check on this task passed.
tasks.scale: 0 below industry standard · 1 meets it · 2 meets it and exceeds it in places · 3 clearly exceeds it.
tasks.noFile: No file was handed in for this task, so it scored 0.
tasks.waitingTrainer: A trainer will confirm this task. The score may change slightly.
tasks.manualCheck: We're checking this file manually. Your score updates when we're done.

ask.label: What do you think is wrong with this result?
ask.hint: Tell us which check you disagree with and why. A trainer will look at your file again.
ask.sent: Question sent. We'll reply by email within 2 working days.
ask.already: You asked about this task. We'll reply by email within 2 working days.
ask.errorEmpty: Write a few words about what looks wrong.
ask.error: We couldn't send your question. Please try again in a minute.
ask.toast: We'll reply by email within 2 working days.

states.gradingText: Most files take a minute or two. This page updates by itself.
states.pollError: We lost contact for a moment. We'll keep trying.
states.manualText: One of your files couldn't be checked automatically, so a trainer is checking it by hand. Your score updates when we're done, and you'll get an email.
states.expiredText: The time ran out before any file was uploaded, so there is nothing to score.
states.retakeOn: You can take the test again on {date}.
states.retakeNow: You can take the test again now.
states.inProgressText: Hand in your files first. Your results appear here after that.

path.title: Your training path
path.purpose: Where to start, ranked by how many marks you can still gain.
path.empty: We'll suggest a path once your results are in.

reason.first: Start with {area}: it's {weight} % of the marks and you scored {percent} %.
reason.next: Then {area}: {weight} % of the marks, you scored {percent} %.
reason.strong: Keep {area} sharp: you scored {percent} % on {weight} % of the marks.

freeLesson.title: Your free lesson
freeLesson.placeholderText: Coming with the training. Your first lesson shows how to turn a sketch into a solid part.

offer.title: Join the training
offer.whatsappText: Hi, I have a question about the CAD Champions training.

share.title: Share your result
share.text: Off by default. When on, anyone with the link sees only your first name, your band and your skill map. Never your tasks or files.
share.savedOn: Sharing is on. Anyone with the link can see your band and skill map.
share.savedOff: Sharing is off. The old link no longer works.
share.error: We couldn't change sharing. Please try again.
share.notReady: You can share once your results are in.

sharePage.purpose: A CAD Champions skill map, shared by the student.
sharePage.heading: {name}'s skill map
sharePage.notFoundText: The student may have turned sharing off.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.help: Your overall score on each test you handed in, oldest on the left.
progress.deltaUp: Up {delta} points since your last test
progress.deltaDown: Down {delta} points since your last test
progress.single: Take the test again later to see your progress.
progress.emptyText: Your progress shows here after your first test is scored.

report.title: CAD Champions skills report
report.name: Name
report.provisional: Provisional: a trainer still needs to confirm part of this result.
report.disclaimer: CAD Champions is a training programme by Gestaltung360. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any competition organiser. Scores are a training estimate, not an official competition result.
report.htmlNote: This is the print version of your report. Open it in your browser and choose Print, then Save as PDF.
